# EvRichEditor

> A rich-text editor input with a formatting toolbar for entering styled, multi-line content. It supports leading/trailing icons, a scrollbar, validation, and the same interaction states as InputField.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:rich-editor` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvRichEditor } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvRichEditor>` or `<ev-rich-editor>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/rich-editor/EvRichEditor.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<div class="ev-rich-editor__body">`, not the root |

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Input**, frame `4690:7715` (InputRichEditor). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to author formatted content (bold, lists, links) such as descriptions or articles.
- Use the toolbar to expose common text-formatting actions.
- Use the scroll variant for long content.
- Use validation text to guide correction inline.
- Use the disabled state when the content is read-only.

### When not to use

- Don't use for short plain text  →  use InputField (`evoq-ui:input`).
- Don't use for unformatted multi-line text  →  use InputTextArea (`evoq-ui:textarea`).
- Don't use when markup output is not supported downstream.
- Don't overload the toolbar with rarely-used actions.

### Do

- Keep the toolbar to the most common formatting actions.
- Show validation text close to the field, on error.
- Allow the editor to grow or scroll for long content.
- Preserve pasted formatting where it is safe to do so.

### Don't

- Rely on the placeholder alone as the label.
- Use red borders without an explanatory message.
- Let content overflow without a scrollbar.
- Disable the editor without making the reason clear.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvRichEditor`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<div class="ev-rich-editor__body">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:rich-editor` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
